hooks.command: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -r "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/dev-server-status.ts" ]; then bun "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/dev-server-status.ts" 2>/dev/null || { cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || while IFS= read -r _; do :; done; printf '%s\n' 'dev-server-status.ts: hook unavailable; allowing this call.' >&2; }; else cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || while IFS= read -r _; do :; done; printf '%s\n' 'dev-server-status.ts: hook unavailable; allowing this call.' >&2; fi

if command -v bash >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/guard-api-commands.sh" ] && command -v cat >/dev/null 2>&1 && err=$(mktemp 2>/dev/null); then trap 'rm -f "$err" 2>/dev/null' EXIT; if bash "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/guard-api-commands.sh" 2>"$err"; then cat "$err" >&2; else cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || while IFS= read -r _; do :; done; echo "Note: stack guard could not run; allowing this call." >&2; fi; else cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || while IFS= read -r _; do :; done; echo "Note: stack guard unavailable; allowing this call." >&2; fi; exit 0
